name: D-28 Dreadnought
description: The legendary Martin D-28 with rich, booming tone and incredible projection.
detailedDescription: The Martin D-28 is one of the most iconic acoustic guitars ever made. Built with a solid Sitka spruce top and East Indian rosewood back and sides, it delivers the classic Martin tone that has defined American music for generations. The forward-shifted X-bracing provides powerful bass response and clear trebles.

name: 814ce Grand Auditorium
description: Premium acoustic-electric with balanced tone and Taylor's Expression System 2.
detailedDescription: The Taylor 814ce features a solid Sitka spruce top with stunning Indian rosewood back and sides. The Grand Auditorium body shape offers excellent balance between bass and treble frequencies. The Expression System 2 electronics capture the guitar's natural acoustic tone with studio-quality clarity.

name: J-45 Standard
description: The workhorse of acoustic guitars with warm, woody tone and vintage appeal.
detailedDescription: The Gibson J-45 has been the choice of countless singer-songwriters since 1942. With its solid Sitka spruce top and mahogany back and sides, it produces a warm, balanced tone perfect for both strumming and fingerpicking. The round shoulder design and traditional X-bracing deliver classic Gibson acoustic character.

name: FG830 Dreadnought
description: Excellent entry-level acoustic with solid spruce top and great playability.
detailedDescription: The Yamaha FG830 offers exceptional value with its solid Sitka spruce top and rosewood back and sides. The traditional Western dreadnought body provides rich, full tone with excellent projection. Die-cast tuners ensure stable tuning, while the nato neck provides comfortable playability for players of all levels.

name: OM-28 Orchestra Model
description: Vintage-inspired orchestra model with balanced tone and superior fingerpicking response.
detailedDescription: The Martin OM-28 combines the best of vintage Martin design with modern craftsmanship. The orchestra model body size offers excellent balance and clarity, making it perfect for fingerpicking and recording. East Indian rosewood back and sides paired with Sitka spruce top create rich harmonics and sustain.

name: Builder's Edition 717e Grand Pacific
description: Premium acoustic-electric with innovative V-Class bracing and stunning aesthetics.
detailedDescription: The Taylor Builder's Edition 717e represents the pinnacle of acoustic guitar innovation. V-Class bracing enhances both volume and sustain while improving intonation up the neck. The Grand Pacific body shape delivers bold, powerful tone with excellent bass response. Premium appointments include Silent Satin finish and chamfered body edges.

name: APX600 Thinline
description: Slim-body acoustic-electric designed for stage performance and amplified playing.
detailedDescription: The Yamaha APX600 features a thin body design that reduces feedback when amplified while maintaining rich acoustic tone. The spruce top and nato back and sides provide balanced sound, while the System66 preamp with onboard tuner makes it perfect for live performance. Comfortable neck profile suits both acoustic and electric players.

name: Hummingbird Studio
description: Iconic square-shoulder dreadnought with distinctive pickguard and powerful projection.
detailedDescription: The Gibson Hummingbird is one of the most visually striking acoustics ever made. Its square-shoulder dreadnought body and distinctive hummingbird pickguard make it instantly recognizable. Sitka spruce top with mahogany back and sides deliver powerful, punchy tone that cuts through any mix. A favorite of recording artists worldwide.

name: GD20CE Dreadnought
description: Affordable acoustic-electric with solid cedar top and reliable electronics.
detailedDescription: The Takamine GD20CE offers excellent value with its solid cedar top that provides warm, rich tone. Mahogany back and sides add depth and resonance, while the TP-4TD preamp system delivers natural amplified sound. The slim mahogany neck and 12-inch radius fretboard provide comfortable playability.

name: PC12CE Grand Concert
description: Compact acoustic-electric with layered koa and comfortable grand concert body.
detailedDescription: The Taylor Academy 12e features a grand concert body that's comfortable for smaller players and excellent for fingerpicking. Layered koa back and sides provide warm, focused tone, while the solid Sitka spruce top ensures good projection. The ES-B pickup system delivers natural acoustic tone when amplified.
